title: Income-tax Act — Section 26 (Property owned by co-owners)

content.overview: Section 26 provides that where property is owned by co-owners and their shares are definite and ascertainable, each is assessed on his share.
content.glance: Section 26 provides that where property is owned by co-owners and their shares are definite and ascertainable, each is assessed on his share.
content.study: Where house property is owned by two or more persons and their respective shares are definite and ascertainable, the share of each person is included in his total income. The co-owners are not assessed as an association of persons on that property.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 26 provides that where property is owned by co-owners and their shares are definite and ascertainable, each is assessed on his share.
